self_reference_policy.note: the prereg commit itself carries prereg_commit = null (a commit cannot embed its own SHA); the resolved SHA is recorded here and in ARC03_PREREG_COMMIT_POINTER.json by the pointer commit [ARC03-PREREG-002]

data_authority_checkpoints: ARC03-DATA-002 resolve raw bytes against the data root and bind the authority commit
ARC03-DATA-003 record portable data-authority verification evidence
ARC03-DATA-004 prove data authority from a clean throwaway worktree

data_authority.source: official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly archives (CHECKSUM verified) + official daily archives for the SOLUSDT 2022-02/2022-04 gaps

funding_authority.classification: REUSABLE (byte-identical reuse of the certified ARC-01 funding authority)
funding_authority.role: CASHFLOW LEG ONLY - funding is never an ARC-03 signal input

reuse_audit.conclusion: no existing authority is reusable: every committed kline authority is 1h or coarser and per-trade coverage is a handful of recent days; ARC-03 therefore acquired its own official 5m bytes

common_causal_window.derivation_basis: provider availability and common coverage only - never returns

frozen_economics.participation_shock: v(t) > max{v(t - 86400000*j) : j = 1..30}; all 30 same-5m-slot references required, else fail closed
frozen_economics.exhaustion: body>0 and (high-close) > range/2 -> SHORT; body<0 and (close-low) > range/2 -> LONG (strict)
frozen_economics.price_context: NONE (OHLC is the definition, not an added filter)
frozen_economics.decision_cadence: one decision per completed 5m bar per asset, at the bar's close_time_ms
frozen_economics.entry: OPEN of the first 5m bar with open_time_ms > decision_time_ms
frozen_economics.exit: OPEN of the bar at entry_open_time_ms + 3600000
frozen_economics.overlap_policy: SKIP while a position is open; no queue, no pyramiding; assets independent; max one position per asset
frozen_economics.funding_cashflow: sum over certified settlements in (entry_time, exit_time] of (-direction_sign * funding_rate); settlement count is never assumed
frozen_economics.kill_rule: ONE PREREGISTRATION -> ONE PRIMARY DISCOVERY; any critical gate failure => ARC03 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (terminal, no retuning)

frozen_artifact_hashes.note: the authoritative digest set is ARC03_MANIFEST_V1.json.frozen_economic_artifacts; scripts/verify_arc03_prereg.py proves drift = 0 against it

data_authority.portable_verifier: PASS (fails closed without a data root)

prereg.portable_prereg_verifier: scripts/verify_arc03_prereg.py -> PASS with a certified data root; FAIL_CLOSED (exit 2) with a wrong one
prereg.unit_tests: tests/unit/research/test_arc03_prereg.py -> 28 passed (synthetic fixtures + real-authority identity checks)

defects.detail: ARC03_SPEC_V1.json marks the participation field as 'v' (the short partition key) while the provider kline field is index 5 (base volume). The mapping is stated in ARC03_DATA_AUTHORITY.json.field_admission and in the reader; no economic ambiguity results.

limitations: The rule is parameter-free; the only length-like constant is the 30-day same-slot reference, frozen ex ante and probed only by the robustness plan.
The common window starts at SOLUSDT's admission (2020-09-14); earlier BTC/ETH history is out of scope.
SOLUSDT 2022-02 and 2022-04 provider gaps were filled from official daily archives (disclosed in the data quality ledger).
The last 60 minutes of the window yields no trades (frozen forward-data guard).
Funding cashflow is charged on the entry notional (frozen O(1e-4) simplification).
No critical gate covers drawdown; drawdown is a diagnostic only.
The H5 collision check required by the ARU kill rule is staged immediately after discovery because evaluating it requires economic observation.
N is a discovery-time unknown; INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE is a possible terminal outcome.
Two HIGH residual risks are disclosed in ARC03_FAILED_MEMORY_COLLISION_REVIEW.md: the 5m cost hurdle (#1) and the secular-uptrend short-fade (#10).
